1 · Intro

When to use it.

Hiring faculty in Oracle uses the same pending worker conversion as staff. The differences are in supplements and costing.

Getting the element and costing right keeps faculty pay out of staff or student accounts.

Use this whenYou are converting or hiring a faculty member and want to know what differs from a staff hire.

HCM Academy job aid · Faculty

Faculty

Use when: You are converting or hiring a faculty member and want to know what differs from a staff hire. · System: Oracle HCM

  1. Convert the pending worker from Our Workforce > Quick Actions (Show More) > Pending Workers.
    • Hire reason: Hire employment
    • Status: Active payroll eligible
  2. Confirm the position is a faculty position, not a repurposed staff position.
  3. Use faculty supplements, not staff supplements.
  4. Check element costing: faculty is account 5110.
  5. Submit, track approval, and confirm I-9 and background check are done.
